rec.name: PDP Product Attributes (Slider Scales)

what.text: A PDP block that shows product-specific qualities as horizontal slider-style scales (e.g. Look: not good → very good, Feeling: short-lived → long-lasting, Vibe: wobbly → robust). It sits in a rounded, tinted card under a heading (the product name in the live example) and below the add-to-cart button and trust box. Each product has its own values. The scales are read-only: the marker position is set from data, and customers cannot move it.

why.text: Rating-style scales make quality, durability and feel quick to scan, which are hard to judge online. They give shoppers concrete evidence near the buy button. They also let shoppers compare products at a glance and reduce uncertainty, particularly for tactile products like toys. This reasoning is inferred and not stated in the ticket.

how.text: Add the 'CRO | Product Attributes' block to the product template in the theme editor, under the buy buttons. Create one metaobject entry per product that holds the attribute titles, the scale end labels and the marker values. Connect that entry to the product through a product metafield, so editing one product's values does not change others. The customer first saw shared values across products. The fix was one unique metaobject entry per product, linked via the metafield. Then style the block in the editor settings.

items: CRO Heading: font size, font weight, font style
CRO Title: font size, font weight, font style, position (left/center/right)
CRO Progress: background color of the bar (more progress styling likely below the visible area)

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify metaobject definition for the attributes and a product metafield that references it. The theme must include the custom 'CRO | Product Attributes' block (built on the Sectionfy theme setup). The block's own note says the Metaobjects and Metafields setup must be completed first. The exact metaobject field structure is not documented in the ticket; a video walkthrough exists but its content is not available here.

items: Scroll depth / visibility of the block
Bounce and exit rate on PDP
